name: Susan Rebecca Merithew (Rosher, Tullar)
milestones: Married Theodore Richard Tullar Sr. (m. 10 Nov 1967)
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Bicha-Dale Family Tree" (tree 8839537)
notes: Child of Harold Romeyn and Cleda Marie (Decker) Merithew; grandchild of Clyde Decker. Born 1 Jun 1936 at Howell, Michigan; died 12 May 1991 at Flint and was buried at Gaines, Genesee County. She married Marvin Kenneth Rosher (1931–1961) about 1960, twice more in the 1960s, and Theodore Richard Tullar Sr. (1935–2010) on 10 Nov 1967; the tree lists eleven children, all living.
